description: Volume control shared by `v-audio` and `v-video`: a mute button with a slider next to it or in a menu.

props.inline: Display slider next to the icon instead of in a menu. `true` places it after the icon; `left` and `right` pin the side regardless of text direction. Recommended to pair with **sliderProps** to configure slider width.
props.slider: `visible` shows the slider, `hover` keeps an **inline** slider collapsed until the control is hovered or focused, `hidden` leaves only the mute button. A menu always opens on hover, so `hover` has no effect there. The slider is always hidden on iOS and iPadOS, which ignore volume set from JavaScript.
props.direction: Switch between horizontal and vertical slider.
props.label: Passed to `aria-label` and, when **inline**, shown in a tooltip. Without it the label comes from the locale.
props.volumeIcon: Icon shown while not muted. When unset, the icon follows the volume level.
props.muteIcon: Icon shown when the volume is 0.
props.menuProps: Props passed to VMenu containing volume slider. The menu opens on hover and focus, and a click on the button toggles mute. On touch, a tap opens and closes the menu instead.
props.sliderProps: Selected props to customize volume slider.
